description: Angular component for configuring notification rules within the Thingsboard platform, including form setup, validation, and interaction logic.

classes.name: RuleNotificationDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for creating and editing notification rules with multiple configuration forms and stepper navigation.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions when the component is destroyed.

methods.name: changeStep
methods.description: Handles step change in the stepper UI.

methods.name: nextStep
methods.description: Advances to the next step or saves the rule if on the last step.

methods.name: nextStepLabel
methods.description: Returns the label for the next step button.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Validates and submits the notification rule form.

methods.name: allValid
methods.description: Checks if all form steps are valid.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Opens dialog to create a notification target.

methods.name: countRecipientsChainConfig
methods.description: Counts the number of escalation targets configured.

methods.name: isSysAdmin
methods.description: Checks if current user has SYS_ADMIN authority.

methods.name: allowTriggerTypes
methods.description: Determines allowed trigger types based on user authority.

methods.name: allowEntityTypeForEntityAction
methods.description: Provides allowed entity types for entity actions, excluding certain types.
